sql.query: SELECT w.id,w.templateId,w.ownerTeamId,w.currentStageId,ws.stageName,ws.requiresProgressionApproval,CAST(COUNT(t.id) AS UNSIGNED) requiredTaskCount,CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status NOT IN ('complete','skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED) blockingTaskCount,CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('waiting','internal_hold','external_hold','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED) blockedTaskCount,CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.responseRequired=1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(t.responseValue),'') IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_task_answers ta WHERE ta.taskId=t.id AND ta.tenantId=t.tenantId) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED) missingResponseCount,CAST(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 AND p.permissionCode='tenant.workflow.stage.approve') AS UNSIGNED) canApprove,CAST(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:moveUser AND utr.tenantId=:moveTenant AND utr.isActive=1 AND p.permissionCode='workflows.edit') AS UNSIGNED) canMove FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages ws ON ws.id=w.currentStageId AND ws.workflowId=w.id AND ws.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_tasks t ON t.workflowStageId=ws.id AND t.workflowId=w.id AND t.tenantId=w.tenantId AND t.isRequired=1 WHERE w.id=:recordId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND (:expectedStage=0 OR w.currentStageId=:expectedStage2) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_workflow_stages nextStage WHERE nextStage.id=ws.nextWorkflowStageId AND nextStage.workflowId=w.id AND nextStage.tenantId=w.tenantId) GROUP BY w.id,ws.id LIMIT 1
SELECT id,completedDate FROM tbl_workflows WHERE id=:recordId AND tenantId=:tenantId AND status='complete' AND currentStageId IS NULL LIMIT 1

sql.query: UPDATE tbl_workflow_stages SET status='complete',startedDate=COALESCE(startedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),completedDate=COALESCE(completedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:stageId AND workflowId=:recordId AND tenantId=:tenantId

UPDATE tbl_workflows SET status='complete',eventStatusId=COALESCE((SELECT es.id FROM tbl_event_statuses es WHERE es.tenantId=:statusTenant AND es.systemCategory='completed' AND es.isActive=1 ORDER BY es.isDefault DESC,es.displayOrder,es.id LIMIT 1),eventStatusId),currentStageId=NULL,completedDate=COALESCE(completedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,rowVersion=rowVersion+1 WHERE id=:recordId AND tenantId=:tenantId AND currentStageId=:expectedStage

sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_activity_log (tenantId,userId,workflowId,entityType,entityId,actionType,summary,afterJson,createdDate) VALUES (:tenantId,:userId,:recordId,'workflow',:recordId2,'workflow.completed',CONCAT(:actor,' approved final phase ',:stageName,' and completed the event'),JSON_OBJECT('transitionType','completed','stageId',:stageId,'comment',NULLIF(:comment,'')),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
